rule: An Antigravity annotation marks its conversation archived when the last `archived` field outside a quoted string says true.

cases.name: archived, as agy writes it with no space after the colon
archived, as agy writes it with a space after the colon and a title before it
cases.text: title:"Daily Briefing"  archived: true  last_user_view_time:{seconds:1  nanos:2}

cases.name: a double-quoted title that contains archived:true does not count
a single-quoted title that contains archived:true does not count
true then false: the last value wins
false then true: the last value wins
a longer field name ending in archived is a different field
the field on its own line, after another field
